name: Konstantinos Tsimikas

career_stints.note: All competitions total across five seasons (2020-2025) as backup/rotation left-back behind Andy Robertson. Premier League-only split: 66 apps, 10 assists. Won Premier League 2024/25, FA Cup 2021/22, two EFL Cups (2021/22, 2023/24), Community Shield 2022/23. Assists not reliably split by competition beyond the PL figure, omitted at the all-comp level rather than guessed. Olympiacos-era stats (2015-2020, including loan spells at Esbjerg and Willem II) were not reliably verifiable from an accessible source and are omitted rather than guessed.

Season-long loan (fell down the pecking order after Kerkez's arrival; Liverpool had initially favoured a sale). All competitions: 25 apps (11 starts), 1 assist, 11 key passes, 65 crosses (15 accurate), 20 tackles. Serie A-only split: 17 matches, 6 starts, 0 goals, 0 assists, 16 clearances. One source's claim of '18 Serie A starts' is inconsistent with the more corroborated 6-start figure across two other sources and was not used. Returned to Liverpool's squad for 2026/27 per data/squad/liverpool_2026_27.json.

notes: basis is prior_club_recent_minutes, not liverpool_recent_minutes, because his entire 2025/26 season was spent on loan at Roma -- he has zero Liverpool minutes in the most recent completed season, despite 114 career Liverpool appearances overall.

Raw Roma totals (crosses, key passes, tackles) were found but not normalized to per-90 rates because total minutes for the season were not verifiable from an accessible source -- left as raw counts in the stint note rather than converted with a guessed minutes figure.

No injury currently listed in data/squad/liverpool_2026_27.json for 2026/27; reporting from thisisanfield.com (April/May 2026) discusses him wanting to stay and a possible Liverpool return, consistent with his presence in the current squad file.
Sources: liverpoolfc.com, liverpool.com, thisisanfield.com, statmuse.com, sportsdunia.com, en.wikipedia.org -- via web search 2026-08-10.
